findings.note: Recovery validates the journal and live-target paths but follows pre/<basename> with read_bytes() without verifying that the backup path resolves inside the batch directory. Because repository-local staging is explicitly unprotected, a planted backup symlink can cause an arbitrary out-of-repository file, including a credential, to be read before the recorded-hash check; if its hash is known and recorded, its bytes can also be restored into an allowlisted artifact. This violates the stated boundary that the resolver never reads a credential or accesses content outside the permitted repository scope.
